ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The figure below is a schematic diagram of contour lines in a certain place. Two geography interest groups camped in the area shown in the figure on September 23; the group at place A saw sunrise at 5:00 (local time), and the group at place B saw sunrise at 5:30 (local time). The relative height of places A and B is 800 meters. <image1> What may be the altitude of place 5?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of contour lines. In the upper right part there are multiple closed contour lines, and A is located inside this relatively higher closed area; B is located on the adjacent lower slope surface near A. The contour-line relationship between A and B in the figure shows that the two are separated by about 4 contour intervals. Place 5 can be seen in the lower right of the figure, located between two contour lines of lower values. Reasoning: The question stem says that on September 23 the group at place A saw sunrise at 5:00, and the group at place B saw sunrise at 5:30. An earlier sunrise indicates that the altitude of place A is higher, so A is higher than B. It is known that the relative height of A and B is 800 meters, and in the figure A and B cross 4 contour intervals, so the contour interval is 800÷4=200 meters. Calculating toward place 5 in the lower right along the contour lines in the figure according to the contour interval of 200 meters, place 5 is between the two contour lines of 400 meters and 600 meters, so its altitude may be taken as 420 meters.
